## connect

Connect Catalogue. `POST /whatsapp-catalog/connect`

Connect a Meta product catalogue to a WhatsApp channel.

Consumes the catalogue token/code from the FBLB dialog, resolves the catalogue id from the token's catalog_management granular scope, and persists the (encrypted) token + catalogue id on the channel.

```php
$result = $sendseven->whatsAppCatalogue()->connect(channelId: 'channel_id');
```

- Scopes: `channels:update`

| Parameter | Type | Required | Description |
|---|---|---|---|
| `$channelId` | `string` | yes | The WhatsApp channel to attach the catalogue to |
| `$code` | `?string` | no | Authorization CODE from the FBLB catalogue dialog. Exchanged server-side for an access token. Provide this OR access_token. |
| `$accessToken` | `?string` | no | A catalogue access token already exchanged client-side. Provide this OR code. |
| `$catalogId` | `?string` | no | Optional explicit catalogue id (e.g. copied from Meta Business Suite, or forwarded from the dialog's session_info). Guaranteed unblock for Coexistence numbers, where no Graph edge auto-returns the linked catalogue id. When supplied it is VERIFIED server-side (GET /{catalog_id}/products) before persisting and may be sent alone (without 'code'/'access_token'), since the channel's own WhatsApp token can read a Business-Manager catalogue. When omitted, the id is auto-resolved from the token's granular catalog_management scope. Must be a numeric Meta id. |
| `$idempotencyKey` | `?string` | no | Repeat a request safely: SendSeven answers a repeat with the first result. One is generated when omitted. |

Returns `CatalogueConnect`. [SendSeven reference](https://api.sendseven.com/api/v1/docs#/WhatsApp%20Catalogue/connect_catalogue_api_v1_whatsapp_catalog_connect_post)

## sendSingleProduct

Send Single Product. `POST /whatsapp-catalog/send-product`

Send a Single Product Message into a conversation.

Fail-closed on Coexistence numbers (409). Enqueues onto the messages-out topic for delivery.

```php
$result = $sendseven->whatsAppCatalogue()->sendSingleProduct(conversationId: 'conversation_id', productRetailerId: 'product_retailer_id');
```

- Scopes: `messages:create`

| Parameter | Type | Required | Description |
|---|---|---|---|
| `$conversationId` | `string` | yes | Conversation to send the product into |
| `$productRetailerId` | `string` | yes | The product SKU / retailer id |
| `$body` | `?string` | no | Optional message body (Meta cap: 1024 chars) |
| `$footer` | `?string` | no | Optional footer (Meta cap: 60 chars) |
| `$idempotencyKey` | `?string` | no | Repeat a request safely: SendSeven answers a repeat with the first result. One is generated when omitted. |

Returns `Message`. [SendSeven reference](https://api.sendseven.com/api/v1/docs#/WhatsApp%20Catalogue/send_single_product_api_v1_whatsapp_catalog_send_product_post)

## sendProductList

Send Product List. `POST /whatsapp-catalog/send-product-list`

Send a Multi-Product Message into a conversation.

Fail-closed on Coexistence numbers (409).

```php

```

- Scopes: `messages:create`

| Parameter | Type | Required | Description |
|---|---|---|---|
| `$conversationId` | `string` | yes | Conversation to send the products into |
| `$headerText` | `string` | yes | Required header text for an MPM (Meta cap: 60 chars) |
